mechanism: Ethambutol can cause optic neuritis and visual disturbances which may be masked or complicated by haloperidol's anticholinergic effects and potential for ocular adverse effects; both drugs have potential CNS effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor visual acuity and ophthalmologic symptoms closely during concurrent use; baseline and periodic ophthalmologic examinations are recommended for patients on ethambutol, particularly when combined with haloperidol.
